pick.name: RTK (Rust Token Killer)
pick.what: PreToolUse hook that compresses output of 100+ dev commands before Claude reads it
pick.why: Targets the biggest input-token sink (test/build/git output); single binary, winget, telemetry off by default
pick.install: brew install rtk (macOS/Linux) or winget install rtk-ai.rtk; then rtk init -g

alts.name: caveman
alts.why: Self-measured 33% fewer input tokens over 54 runs; only ~3% better than 'be concise' on output

alts.name: Built-in /context + plugin context-cost pruning
alts.what: See per-plugin always-on cost and drop unused ones
alts.why: Removing plugins/MCPs saves more than any compressor
alts.free_limits: Requires a Claude plan (Pro/Max plans/Team/Enterprise) or API billing; counts against plan usage

candidates.name: headroom MCP
candidates.verdict: MCP mode only helps when Claude calls it; proxy mode intercepts API traffic - overlaps RTK

decision: Prune unused plugins and MCP servers first, then RTK compresses command output automatically with no MCP calls. Skip any overlapping context-compression MCP once RTK is in. Note RTK's engine is BUSL-1.1.

verify.note: Shallow check: no neutrality, pricing or licence defect found; not re-fetched.
